name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for rental property restoration?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for rental property restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor, look for experience specifically in rental property restoration and a strong local reputation. Verify their licensing, insurance, and references. Request detailed proposals and compare bids, ensuring they include clear timelines and cost breakdowns. A good contractor should also communicate effectively and understand landlord-specific needs like minimizing vacancy periods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in rental restoration, proper licensing, insurance, strong references, and clear communication.
